newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to discuss Norway fishmeal import duty refunds.
newsitem.headline: EU to discuss Norway fishmeal import duty refunds.

text.p: European Union cereals experts will discuss on Thursday a proposed regulation allowing importers of Norwegian fishmeal to claim refunds of duty paid for imports made in 1995, an EU official said.

"Detailed rules dating back to January 1, 1995 were not drawn up until February 1996. Denmark and Sweden have made claims amounting to 400 tonnes and 900 tonnes respectively and that is more than the quota allows.

"The Commission's intention is to publish a regulation allowing all operators to reclaim duty and then to settle with a scaled back calculation giving everyone part of their claim," the official said.
The item may be voted at the cereals management committee which follows the experts group meeting.
